verdict.rationale: The UK Intellectual Property Office is a government registry and filing service for trade marks, patents and designs, not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external tool servers is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any agentic or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
